decision: Posted-pick rule replaced, written before any result under the new rule. Old rule (model win chance >= 60%, most likely first) is retired. New rule: a pick is a FanDuel prop whose FanDuel price beats the fair price by markets.prop.min_ev (5%, the pre-registered props selection rule), where the fair chance is the DraftKings two-way price for the same player/stat/line from the same odds response with the margin removed; ranked by that edge; one per player, one per game, max 6; FanDuel price at least 1.50; quote <= 120 min old; >= 20 min to tip; no unresolved injury on the player or a key player in the game. The prop model's weight in the fair chance is 0 (leans.model_weight) until a model passes the props paper gate. Picks are recorded and graded at the FanDuel price. Parlays/lotto are posted only when their combined edge clears markets.parlay/lotto min_ev from legs with edge >= 2.5% (leans.tickets_require_edge; false restores the 2026-10-27 always-post rule). Posted picks are re-checked on every pre-tip run and the result is recorded as advice; a pick is never removed or regraded. Every two-way quote fetched is stored in data/ledger/fd_quotes/ so the rule can be scored later. This rule is NOT validated: there is no historical FanDuel prop price to test it on. It stays research; promotion needs the forward gates in config/gates.yaml. Also: prop demotion calibration gate needs 500 time-ordered settled props (the unordered 150-prop window demoted props-v1 on noise on 2026-11-02; fix taken from draft PR 15).
